headline: Executive order closed most federal government offices on Friday, December 26, 2008, the day after Christmas.
what_it_does: This order closed executive departments and agencies of the federal government on Friday, December 26, 2008. That gave many federal workers the day off right after the Christmas holiday. No summary was provided, so details such as exceptions for certain workers are not covered here.

who_it_affects.how: Many were excused from work on December 26, 2008, because their offices were closed.

who_it_affects.group: People needing in-person help from federal agencies
who_it_affects.how: Federal offices covered by the order were closed that day, so in-person services may not have been available.
